question: Identify the full address (Street, City, State, Zip) of the non-charter school in Los Angeles County with the lowest excellence rate among schools that have an eligible free meal rate for K–12 students below 1%.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T2."XCL_048", T2."XCL_050", T2."XCL_052", T2."XCL_051"
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1."XCL_030" = T2."XCL_041"
INNER JOIN frpm AS T3 ON T2."XCL_041" = T3."XCL_001"
WHERE T2."XCL_045" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2."XCL_063" = 0
  AND CAST(T3."XCL_020" AS REAL) / T3."XCL_019" < 0.01
ORDER BY CAST(T1."XCL_040" AS REAL) / T1."XCL_036" ASC
LIMIT 1
